newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish single digit CPI still far away - c.banker.
newsitem.headline: Polish single digit CPI still far away - c.banker.

text.p: The President of the National Bank of Poland (NBP) said it will be difficult to stiffle year-on-year inflaiton to single digits within the next two years, PAP news agency reported on Monday.
"It will be problematic to reach single digit inflation within two years," PAP quoted Hanna Gronkiewicz-Waltz as saying at a banking conference in Warsaw.
Gronkiewicz-Waltz said the main obstacle in reducing price growth, from year-on-year 19.5 percent in September, was budget expenditures for social programmes such as pensions and retirement funds.
She said that neither the draft 1997 budget nor the following year's budget were likely to curb such spending.
Under the 1997 draft budget year-on-year inflation should fall to 13 percent by the end of next year.
